intro.text: A Veden brightlord, vassal of House Davar and father of Eylita.

items.text: Tavinar and his family visited Lin Davar when he announced his betrothal to Malise Gevelmar; they were plainly uneasy and left as soon as they could. Afterwards Tavinar came to dislike the Davars, so Eylita had to visit them in secret.

While he and his wife spent a month in Alethkar, Eylita planned to elope with Balat, though it never happened. Tavinar seems to have relented afterwards, since Eylita and Balat became formally betrothed.
After the Veden civil war, Eylita reached Urithiru without either of her parents.

personality.text: Close to his daughter, giving her plenty of freedom as long as she keeps a handmaid with her.
Wary of Lin Davar but a careful, loyal vassal.
